mainText: Hello, Verona! At 12 AM, here is today's balanced dish. Expect temperatures around 69 degrees with partly cloudy skies near Reddan Soccer Park. We have a Waxing Gibbous moon, and the ISS will be visible tonight starting at 4:11 AM for three minutes, traveling from the Northwest over Cross Plains toward the Northeast near Madison.

The City of Verona is working on a new Comprehensive Plan to guide future growth and development through 2026. They have established a task force and a project website called Envision Verona to keep residents informed and involved in the planning process.
There is a busy lineup in Verona today, featuring Live Music at Paddy Mac's, Yoga at Insight Wellness, the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market, and Trivia Night at The Bogey Factory.
The Verona Police Department released their weekly report for the period of August 17 to August 24, noting a specific incident involving a DOC warrant.
You can look forward to the delicious Chocolate Caramel Twist as your flavor of the day. The store opens today at 10:00 AM, so plan your visit to enjoy a treat.
